provider: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection via the California Open Data CKAN catalogue
api_version: CKAN Action API 3, package_show for the exact DINS package UUID

request_contract.parameter_rules: Exactly one maintainer-triggered, read-only CKAN Action package_show metadata GET for fixed id=1fdaea07-4bcd-4795-aa88-cd72b98e8a03; immutable route, exactly one request, descriptive user agent, at most 65,536 original response bytes, timeout 30 seconds, no redirect/retry/authentication. Require original package ID/name, public/cc-by fields, frozen modified date and all eleven original resource IDs/formats. Respond to any drift with BLOCKED and review. No following returned resource URLs, ArcGIS queries, CSV/GeoJSON/ZIP downloads, feature IDs, address/APN/individual inspection reads, bulk harvesting, pagination, caller-selected host/URLs, parameters or headers. The historical 2026-11-01 body receipt is a reference only; this contract authorizes a bounded future *metadata* probe, not third-party source data retention.

response_contract.format: CKAN package_show JSON object success=true with one fixed CAL FIRE DINS package id/name, public accessLevel, cc-by metadata label, metadata_modified=2026-10-21T20:55:50.264159, and precisely 11 format/id-tagged resources. Resource URLs are metadata pointers, not permission to download assets.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: This public catalogue metadata establishes a dataset listing, version marker and references to 11 published formats; it does NOT establish actual resource byte availability, inspection count, event identity, scientific coverage, commercial CAT reuse, building exposure denominator, claim loss, or provider feature service usage rights.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Provider documentation on 2026-11-12 lists 60 anonymous requests/minute/IP and asks automated clients to identify with descriptive User-Agent. This workflow deliberately allows ONE manual fixed metadata request only (not weekly polling), no retries, no bulk and no additional data resources. Separate review required before any higher cadence, feature access, raw sample retention or commercial bulk use.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: The package is mutable and includes resource IDs and metadata_modified; as captured at 2026-11-01T18:01:22Z the original UTF-8 JSON body length is 16916 bytes and SHA-256 is 1998a87aff518a059162d9c4faff3ce3c2e145f007323c6a91cf3fb3617927f8. Exact-byte replays may change and must fail closed against this snapshot rather than silently replace it.

rights_and_policy.notes: The official state developer docs explicitly allow public anonymous CKAN reads, describe automated access and a 60/minute/IP limit, and require a descriptive User-Agent for automation. CAL FIRE's exact DINS package page labels metadata public, no restrictions on public use and Creative Commons Attribution. 'allowed' here applies only to one bounded CKAN package metadata GET under these provider conditions; NOT to ArcGIS service, individual inspection details, personal/address/APN attributes, bulk commercial mining, raw feature redistribution or insurance/CAT modelling. Any upstream contributor rights exceptions still require asset-specific review.

expected_evidence: exact fixed CKAN package_show URL, one anonymous GET and descriptive User-Agent
200 application/json original response, <=65536 bytes, no redirect/retry
strict 11-resource public package metadata and 2026-10-21 reviewed snapshot identity
retrieval UTC, request and original response SHA-256, contract/code identity
no provider response text, URLs, addresses, contacts or original raw bytes retained

notes: Authoritative state CKAN metadata route and individual provider DINS package were reviewed 2026-11-12. Exactly one manually dispatched bounded public metadata canary is enabled; original historical 16,916-byte SHA receipt and strict eleven-resource preflight are retained. A changed public package version must fail closed rather than silently update. Asset downloading, independent scientific damage modelling, commercial bulk and address/parcel access remain separate blocked gates; no data admission or Neon write.
